INSERT INTO TB_ORDER (ORDER_ID, MEMBER_ID, ORDER_DT, ORDER_STATUS, TOTAL_AMT, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (SEQ_ORDER_ID.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{orderDt}, '10', #{totalAmt}, #{regId}, SYSDATE)
SELECT SEQ_ORDER_ID.CURRVAL FROM DUAL

INSERT INTO TB_ORDER_HIST (HIST_ID, ORDER_ID, ORDER_STATUS, CHG_DT, CHG_ID) SELECT SEQ_ORDER_HIST_ID.NEXTVAL, O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_STATUS, SYSDATE, #{userId} FROM TB_ORDER O WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT SEQ_PAYMENT_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_PAYMENT (PAYMENT_ID, ORDER_ID, PAY_METHOD_CD, PAY_AMT, PAY_STATUS, PAY_DT) VALUES (#{paymentId}, #{orderId}, #{payMethodCd}, #{payAmt}, 'DONE', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT P.PAYMENT_ID, P.ORDER_ID, P.PAY_METHOD_CD, (SELECT C.CODE_NM FROM TB_CODE C WHERE C.GROUP_CD = 'PAY_METHOD' AND C.CODE = P.PAY_METHOD_CD) AS PAY_METHOD_NM, P.PAY_AMT, P.PAY_STATUS, TO_CHAR(P.PAY_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS PAY_DT FROM TB_PAYMENT P WHERE P.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY P.PAYMENT_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ORDER O SET (O.ORDER_STATUS, O.UPD_DT) = (SELECT DECODE(P.PAY_STATUS, 'DONE', '20', '10'), SYSDATE FROM TB_PAYMENT P WHERE P.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND P.PAYMENT_ID = #{paymentId}) WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_PAYMENT P2 WHERE P2.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND P2.PAYMENT_ID = #{paymentId})
UPDATE TB_PAYMENT SET PAY_STATUS = 'CANCEL' WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND PAY_STATUS = 'DONE'

UPDATE (SELECT D.DELIVERY_STATUS, D.SHIP_DT, O.ORDER_STATUS FROM TB_DELIVERY D, TB_ORDER O WHERE D.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID AND O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND O.ORDER_STATUS = '30') SET DELIVERY_STATUS = 'SHIP', SHIP_DT = SYSDATE
mapper.select: SELECT H.HIST_ID, H.ORDER_ID, H.ORDER_STATUS, C.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM, H.CHG_DT, H.CHG_ID, O.TOTAL_AMT FROM TB_ORDER_HIST H JOIN TB_ORDER O ON O.ORDER_ID = H.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CODE C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'ORDER_STATUS' AND C.CODE = H.ORDER_STATUS WHERE H.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY H.CHG_DT DESC
